subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept persisted `announceLastRun` plus `killed` non-running reconciliation as the canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those turns always tool-free?
rationale: The patch fixes the cascade, but it intentionally changes durable session lifecycle semantics and tool-boundary behavior for a gateway restart path that code review cannot choose on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Treat subagent completion announce turns as delivery-only, tool-free runs and reconcile lost announce starts to a non-running `killed` topic state.

options.title: Adjust the idle state
options.body: Keep the tool-free invariant but change the reconcile patch to a maintainer-preferred non-running status before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader model
options.body: Defer this branch if announce delivery needs a larger lifecycle model instead of an announce-specific marker.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Treat subagent completion announce turns as delivery-only, tool-free runs and reconcile lost announce starts to a non-running `killed` topic state.

likelyOwner.reason: The restart lifecycle seam and Codex/tool-surface history make this the strongest available routing signal for the session-state and tool-boundary choice.
